e.body:
**choicer** 是定价问题的**需求侧工具箱**。可核实信息：**版本 0.2.1、2026-09-04 发布**（比本轮窗口起点早一天，属同一周新包）、**LGPL (≥ 3)**、作者 **Fernando Cordeiro**、**Depends R ≥ 4.1.0**、Imports `data.table`、`nloptr`、`randtoolbox`、`Rcpp`、**LinkingTo `Rcpp`/`RcppArmadillo`（NeedsCompilation: yes）**、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.choicer`、含 vignette、仓库与文档站均 HTTP 200 实测（`github.com/fpcordeiro/choicer`、`fpcordeiro.github.io/choicer/`）。

能力（据 CRAN 描述）：覆盖 **MNL（多项 Logit）**、**MXL（混合 Logit）**、**NL（嵌套 Logit）**、**贝叶斯多项 Probit（MNP）**与**分层贝叶斯 MNL/MNP（HMNL、HMNP）**；似然、梯度与 Hessian 用 **C++ + OpenMP** 实现，可扩展到含大量备选特定常数的设定；**事后计算**覆盖**预测份额、自身与交叉价格弹性、转移比（diversion ratios）、支付意愿（WTP）与福利反事实**。

对 RIAA：上一轮刚收的 [[pricingbandits]] 解决的是**「在不知道需求曲线时边定价边学」**，而 choicer 解决的是**「用已有数据把需求曲线估出来」**——两者是一个问题的两端，合起来才构成池内此前缺失的**需求侧**。为什么这对保险重要：保费定价课程教的是**成本侧**（频率×强度＋费用＋利润），但**「保费涨 5%，会流失多少客户、他们跑去哪家」**才是定价决策真正要回答的问题；其中**转移比**尤其贴合现实——**比价平台让投保人只需点一下就能换公司**，此时「涨价后的去向」比「涨价的平均弹性」更关键，因为它决定**哪些险种/渠道可以涨价、哪些一涨就空心化**。**交叉价格弹性**还直接对应监管与公平议题：某类客户补贴另一类客户的程度，本质上就是交叉弹性在起作用（可对照 [[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[insurance-bunching]]）。相关条目：[[pricingbandits]]（在线学习定价）、[[insurance-uplift]]（该不该营销这个客户）、[[rate-optimiser]]（费率优化）、[[price-contour]]（价格等高线）、[[insurance-online]]（在线投保行为）、[[insurance-pricing-demo]]（定价演示）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 这是**应用经济学的通用离散选择实现，并非保险专用**；**②** 保险需求估计有其特殊约束——**逆选择、续保动态、监管对差异定价的限制**，弹性与 WTP 的估计结果须结合这些条件解读，**直接照搬零售结论会出错**；**③** 版本 **0.2.1** 仍属早期，且需编译 C++；**④** 本轮只核实到 CRAN 页面与仓库/文档站层面，**未运行代码、未做弹性估计的实证验证**。**核实说明**：CRAN 页面、GitHub 仓库页（363KB）与文档站（36KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐项读取；**未运行、未复现**。
e.body_en:
**choicer** is a **demand-side toolbox for pricing**. Verifiable details: **version 0.2.1, published 2026-09-04** (one day before this round’s window start, from the same week), **LGPL (≥ 3)**, author **Fernando Cordeiro**, **Depends R ≥ 4.1.0**, Imports `data.table`, `nloptr`, `randtoolbox`, `Rcpp`, **LinkingTo `Rcpp`/`RcppArmadillo` (NeedsCompilation: yes)**, DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.choicer`, with a vignette; the repository and docs site both measured HTTP 200 (`github.com/fpcordeiro/choicer`, `fpcordeiro.github.io/choicer/`).

Capabilities (per the CRAN description): **MNL (multinomial logit)**, **MXL (mixed logit)**, **NL (nested logit)**, **Bayesian multinomial probit (MNP)** and **hierarchical Bayesian MNL/MNP (HMNL, HMNP)**; likelihoods, gradients and Hessians are implemented in **C++ with OpenMP**, scaling to specifications with many alternative-specific constants; **post-estimation** covers **predicted shares, own- and cross-price elasticities, diversion ratios, willingness to pay and welfare counterfactuals**.

For RIAA: [[pricingbandits]], added last round, addresses **"learn the demand curve while pricing"**; choicer addresses **"estimate the demand curve from data you already have"** — two ends of one problem that together supply the **demand side** this corpus previously lacked. Why it matters for insurance: premium pricing courses teach the **cost side** (frequency × severity + expenses + profit), but **"if the premium rises 5%, how many customers leave and where do they go?"** is the question a pricing decision actually turns on. **Diversion ratios** are especially apt here — **comparison sites let a policyholder switch insurer with one click**, so "where the business goes after a price rise" matters more than the average elasticity, because it determines **which lines and channels can carry a rate increase and which empty out if they try**. **Cross-price elasticities** also map directly onto regulatory and fairness debates: the degree to which one class of customers subsidises another *is* cross-elasticity at work (compare [[fair-pricing-playbook]], [[insurance-bunching]]). Related: [[pricingbandits]] (online learning of prices), [[insurance-uplift]] (whether to target a customer), [[rate-optimiser]] (rate optimisation), [[price-contour]] (price contours), [[insurance-online]] (online buying behaviour), [[insurance-pricing-demo]] (pricing demos).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this is **a general applied-economics discrete-choice implementation, not an insurance-specific tool**; **②** insurance demand has its own constraints — **adverse selection, renewal dynamics and regulatory limits on differentiated pricing** — so elasticity and WTP estimates must be read against those conditions, **and retail conclusions cannot simply be transplanted**; **③** version **0.2.1** is still early and requires compiling C++; **④** this check reached the CRAN page, repository and docs site only — **the code was not run and no empirical elasticity estimate was validated**. **Verification note**: the CRAN page, the GitHub repository page (363KB) and the docs site (36KB) were all measured at HTTP 200 and read item by item; **nothing was run or reproduced**.

能力：**MNL**、**MXL（混合 Logit）**、**NL（嵌套 Logit）**、**貝葉斯多項 Probit**與**分層貝葉斯 MNL/MNP**；似然、梯度與 Hessian 用 **C++ + OpenMP** 實現；**事後計算**覆蓋**預測份額、自身與交叉價格彈性、轉移比、支付意願（WTP）與福利反事實**。

對 RIAA：[[pricingbandits]] 解決**「邊定價邊學需求曲線」**，choicer 解決**「用已有數據估出需求曲線」**，兩者是一體兩面，合起來補上池內此前缺失的**需求側**。保費定價課程教的是**成本側**，但**「保費漲 5%，會流失多少客戶、跑去哪家」**才是定價決策真正的問題；**轉移比**尤其貼合現實——**比價平台讓投保人一鍵換公司**，此時「漲價後的去向」比「平均彈性」更關鍵。相關：[[pricingbandits]]、[[insurance-uplift]]、[[rate-optimiser]]、[[price-contour]]、[[insurance-online]]、[[insurance-pricing-demo]]、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[insurance-bunching]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 這是**應用經濟學通用實現，並非保險專用**；**②** 保險需求有**逆選擇、續保動態、監管對差異定價的限制**，**直接照搬零售結論會出錯**；**③** 版本 **0.2.1** 仍早期且需編譯 C++；**④** 本輪只核實到 CRAN 頁面與倉庫/文檔站，**未運行代碼**。**核實說明**：三處均 HTTP 200 實測並逐項讀取；**未運行、未複現**。
